Case No. 364/2023 dated 12-08-2023 under Sections 498A/323/325/406/34 IPC, instituted another case being Monteswar P. S. Case No. 300 of 2023 dated 05-06-2023 under Sections 498A/406/323 IPC.

sentences.text:
Having regard to the fact that within close proximity of two months two cases under Section 498A IPC and allied sections have been instituted at the instance of the de facto complainant, I am inclined to stay the second case being Barddhaman Women P. S. Case No. 364/2023 dated 12-08-2023 before the learned CJM, Purba Bardhaman till 31st August, 2024.
In the meantime, the petitioners would effect service upon the opposite party no.1 through the office of the Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta and also upon the opposite party no.2 by speed post with acknowledgment due and file affidavit of service on the next date fixed for hearing.

entities.text: Barddhaman Women P. S. Case No. 364/2023
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Matter be listed under the heading "Contested Application" in the monthly list of August, 2024.

All concerned parties are to act in terms of a copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this court.
[Tirthankar Ghosh, J]
